body.content:
Sir,

Attached is the draft AMC Campaign Plan for FY26-30. This strategic document outlines our command priorities for precision sustainment and materiel readiness over the next five years.

Four Strategic Lines of Effort:

1. Modernize Sustainment Infrastructure
   - Depot modernization ($2.1B investment)
   - Digital transformation initiatives
   - Supply chain optimization

2. Build Technical Excellence
   - Workforce development and retention
   - Advanced manufacturing capabilities
   - Partnership with industry and academia

3. Strengthen Global Partnerships
   - Foreign Military Sales support
   - Allied nation depot partnerships
   - Security Cooperation programs

4. Drive Innovation and Agility
   - Predictive maintenance and AI
   - Additive manufacturing expansion
   - Rapid prototyping capabilities

Key Metrics for Success:
- Equipment readiness: Maintain >90%
- Depot throughput: Increase 25%
- Supply chain efficiency: Reduce lead times 30%
- Workforce readiness: Fill 95% of critical positions

Request your review and feedback by 20 November. Plan to brief at December Senior Leader Forum for final approval.

Respectfully,
MG Sarah Henderson
Chief of Staff
Army Materiel Command
